description: Schedules a Reddit post or comment to be made later as the connected account, at `run_at` (60 seconds to 30 days ahead). At that time the stored request runs through the same path a live post submission or comment takes, as the Reddit session connected when it runs, so a session logged out in between makes the run fail without a charge. A public action on Reddit under the customer's name, marked as a write so a client can ask before it runs; a subreddit's rules decide whether a post stays up. Due actions are picked up every 30 seconds and run one at a time, normally within about a minute of `run_at`. A failed run is not retried: it is recorded as failed with Reddit's reason. Up to 100 actions can wait per account (409 SCHEDULE_LIMIT_REACHED past that). Scheduling is free; a run that succeeds is billed at the write rate to this API key, and a failed or cancelled one is not charged. With no connected session it answers 400 SESSION_NOT_CONNECTED. Returns 201 with `action`: `id`, `type`, `status` (scheduled), `run_at`, the stored `request`, `created_at`, `finished_at`, `result`, `error` and `billed`.

request.description: The body the live route takes, without cookies or a proxy. A post takes subreddit, kind and title, plus text or url and the optional flair and flag fields; a comment takes post_url and text. A field that does not belong to the type is refused with a 400 naming it.

flair_id.description: Post: post flair template id, for subreddits that require flair.

flair_text.description: Post: post flair text, when the flair template allows editing it.

kind.description: Post: self = text post, link = URL post. Required for a post.

post_url.description: Comment: the reddit.com post URL to comment on. Required for a comment.

sendreplies.description: Post: send inbox replies to the account.

spoiler.description: Post: mark the post as a spoiler.

subreddit.description: Post: subreddit name, without r/. Required for a post.

text.description: Post: body text, for kind self. Comment: the comment text, up to 10,000 characters, required.

title.description: Post: title, up to 300 characters. Required for a post.

url.description: Post: target URL, for kind link.

run_at.description: When it runs: an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone (e.g. '2026-10-21T15:00:00Z' or '2026-10-21T17:00:00+02:00') or Unix seconds. 60 seconds to 30 days ahead. A timestamp without a zone is refused.

type.description: post = a new post in a subreddit, comment = a comment on a post.

name: reddit_scheduled_create
title: Schedule Reddit Action
